figure.alt: Diagram of Stardew Valley harvest controls: Right-Click or X for a parsnip, Left-Click or C with a scythe for kale, wheat, amaranth, unmilled rice, and fiber, an axe for a giant crop, plus trellis and season-change rules.
figure.caption: Schematic: Stardew Valley crop harvest methods, with Right-Click or X for a parsnip, a scythe swing for kale, wheat, amaranth, unmilled rice, and fiber, plus an axe for giant crops, blocked trellises, and the day-28 season change.
figure.creationBasis: Original vector diagram for this article. Labels use role A harvest facts: PC parsnip right-click and the hold on the tile you stand on, scythe crops, Iridium Scythe on tilled soil from 1.6, axe harvest for a giant crop, blocked trellis crops, and the day-28 season change with a year-round greenhouse. Geometric cards and key chips are original. Not a game screenshot and not a wiki image. WebP and AVIF files are not created in this pass; Role G rasterizes the SVG at 1672 by 941.
